prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Split Layout: Reconstruct the story introductory screen into a split layout to present story lore on one side and immediate path selection on the other.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose how you want your pet to live on your desktop."}}
1: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Desktop Sync Assurance Notification: Add an automated readiness notification on the sign-in screen reassuring users that desktop pet data will sync immediately upon login.
   config: {"sign_in": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Your desktop pet, memory, and settings sync securely across sign-ins."}}
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Add a photo lighting guidance hint with tip delay on the upload_photos screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best custom pet accuracy, upload clear, well-lit photos without heavy shadows.", "tip_delay_seconds": 3}}
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Stage Companion Care Tips: Display time estimate and a tip carousel component on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 4, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "label": "Tip: Your pet will react to your mouse movement and sound on the desktop.", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Command Hub Redesign: Redesign the home_intro welcome screen using component replace to explicitly display mascot guidance and right-click control instructions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_welcome", "style": "playful", "role": "home_welcome"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Right-click your pet at any time on your desktop to open controls, talk, or hide.", "style": "emphasis", "role": "home_welcome"}]}}}
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Decision Companion Preview Screen: Add a new screen 'new_path_preview' between story and choose_path to show interactive previews of companion path choices.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_preview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_preview": {"headline": "Preview Your Companion Experience", "body": "Explore how each companion path changes how your pet behaves on your desktop.", "layout": "centered"}}
6: [adoption, reorder] Adoption Certificate Name First Reorder: Reorder adoption screens so adoption_certificate comes directly after pick_friend and before upload_photos.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "adoption_certificate", "upload_photos", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
7: [finish, new_flow] Finish Stage Desktop Dock Tutorial Flow: Introduce a new screen 'new_desktop_dock_intro' in the finish step with a checklist layout covering tray controls and desktop overlay behavior.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_dock_intro"], "new_desktop_dock_intro": {"headline": "Desktop Dock & Controls Overview", "body": "Learn how to toggle pet visibility, dock to system tray, and access quick commands.", "layout": "checklist"}}
8: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Existing Pet Recovery Copy: Update the headline and body copy on sign_in to assure returning users their pet progress and account state will be restored.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore & Sync Your Pet", "body": "Signing in secures your companion's memory, customization, and settings across sessions."}}
9: [adoption, incentive] Pick Friend Companion Trait Badge Incentive: Add a highlight trait badge component to the pick_friend screen emphasizing unique pet desktop animations.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Includes Custom Desktop Animations", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning story screen layout and text within onboarding is allowed and maintains all required screen functions.
Adding a sync assurance hint to sign_in is allowed within onboarding.
Adding photo lighting guidance to upload_photos is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a tip carousel and time estimate to waiting screen is allowed.
Redesigning home_intro controls guidance with components is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a path preview screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Placing adoption certificate before photo upload breaks the certificate job, as custom pets cannot be certified before photos are uploaded.
Adding a new tutorial screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed within onboarding.
Updating sign_in copy to mention pet sync and recovery is allowed within onboarding.
Adding feature badges on pick_friend without mentioning pricing or unfair incentives is allowed.
